q_45081.question_text: How many viewers will Newsmax report having in the second quarter of 2026?
q_45081.reasoning:
# Analysis of Newsmax Q2 2026 Viewer Forecast

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution
Today is July 31, 2026. Newsmax is scheduled to report Q2 2026 results on Thursday, August 13, 2026, after market close. This is **13 days away** — extremely close to resolution. The actual data will be published within two weeks.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

**Starting point: Q1 2026 = 30.4 million viewers**

The research provides crucial momentum data:
- Q1 2026: 30.4 million total viewers
- Q1 to Q4 2025: +29% quarter-over-quarter growth
- April 2026 (the first month of Q2): 16.6 million viewers, representing +27% year-over-year growth

**Key insight on April 2026:** The 16.6 million viewers in April represents approximately 55% of the Q1 quarterly total (16.6/30.4 ≈ 0.55). This is reasonable for a single month within a quarter, suggesting the quarterly run rate is continuing at or slightly below Q1 levels.

If we assume April's 16.6 million is representative of the quarter (which would give us ~49.8M), this would be too high — it's unlikely May and June sustained April's exact pace. More realistically, if April represents the middle month at a slightly elevated level and the quarter averages somewhat lower, we'd expect the full Q2 to be in the range of 32-35 million.

However, the trajectory shows sequential growth:
- Q4 2025 to Q1 2026: +29% growth
- April 2026 (YoY): +27% growth

**Most likely scenario:** Q2 2026 shows modest growth or stability relative to Q1 2026 (30.4M), landing in the **31-33 million range**. Cable news viewership can be volatile based on news cycles, election proximity (we're 3+ months from November 2026 general elections, reducing political urgency), and competitor dynamics.

The fact that April showed strong YoY growth (+27%) but came in at only 16.6M (vs Q1's 30.4M quarterly average) suggests some moderation occurred in May-June, or April was an anomalously strong month.

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

- **Seasonal decline**: Summer months traditionally see lower cable news viewership as audiences engage in outdoor activities
- **News cycle normalization**: If April's +27% YoY growth was driven by specific news events, those could dissipate
- **Competitive pressures**: Other cable news channels (Fox News, CNN, MSNBC) could gain share
- **Loss of momentum**: The +29% Q4-to-Q1 growth spurt could be unsustainable
- **Reporting conservatism**: Companies sometimes report conservative figures after strong quarters

**Floor scenario**: If Q2 reverts toward a normalized seasonal pattern and loses some of Q1's momentum, we could see **27-28 million** viewers.

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

- **Sustained growth trajectory**: If the +29% Q1 and +27% April growth trends continue, Q2 could exceed 35M
- **Election cycle effects**: Even though the general election is 3+ months away, political coverage and polarization could drive viewership
- **Market share gains**: Newsmax has been positioning itself as the #4 cable news channel; continued audience acquisition could push higher
- **Network expansion or promotional success**: New content, stronger on-air talent, or marketing could drive growth
- **News-driven spikes**: Major geopolitical or domestic events could boost viewership

**Ceiling scenario**: If April's 16.6M was representative and the quarter sustains that level across all three months, we could see **~49M** (though this seems high based on quarterly averages typically exceeding monthly data by 3-4x).

More realistically, strong sustained growth could bring us to **33-35 million**.

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

**From the research provided:**
- Q4 2025: ~23.6 million (calculated from Q1's 30.4M being +29% vs Q4)
- Q1 2026: 30.4 million (stated explicitly)
- April 2026: 16.6 million (stated as first month of Q2)
- Q1 to Q4 growth: +29%
- April YoY growth: +27%

**Pattern observed:** Newsmax has shown strong growth momentum from late 2025 into early 2026. However, single-month April data (16.6M) at only ~55% of quarterly average suggests the quarterly average is higher than one month would indicate.

**No reliable external base rate** for cable news quarterly seasonal patterns in the provided materials, but the Q4→Q1 momentum combined with April's ongoing growth suggests **continuation near Q1 levels or modest increase to 31-33M is most probable**.

---

## Final Estimate

Given:
- Q1 2026 baseline of 30.4M
- April 2026 strength of 16.6M (suggesting May-June moderation from April's peaks)
- Strong but potentially unsustainable growth trajectory
- Traditional summer viewership seasonality
- High data quality (reporting in 13 days; we're very close to resolution)

**I estimate Q2 2026 total viewers will be approximately 31.5 million**, with reasonable confidence in the 30-33M range.

q_45081.research_text:
Newsmax is scheduled to report its second-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, August 13, 2026, after the U.S. stock market closes [blackberryempire.com](https://lifestyle.blackberryempire.com/story/262563/newsmax-to-report-second-quarter-2026-financial-results/). Management will host a conference call the same day at 4:30 PM ET to discuss the results.

In the first quarter of 2026, Newsmax reported a total audience reach of 30.4 million viewers and 13.3 million Adults 35-64, solidifying its position as the fourth highest-rated cable news channel [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2026478/000202647826000046/nmax_q12026earningsrelease.htm). This represented a 29% increase in total viewers compared to Q4 2025, and a 41% increase in the Adults 35-64 demographic [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2026478/000202647826000046/newsmaxirpresentation511.htm). Social media followers also rose to 24.7 million as of March 31, 2026 [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2026478/000202647826000046/nmax_q12026earningsrelease.htm). Newsmax's total audience reach in April 2026 was 16.6 million viewers, a 27% increase year-over-year, with over 7 million viewers in the key 35-64 demographic [ir.newsmax.com](https://ir.newsmax.com/news/news-details/2026/Newsmax-Audience-Surges-in-April-Hits-Records-in-Growth/default.aspx). Newsmax anticipates full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $212 million to $216 million [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2026478/000202647826000046/nmax_q12026earningsrelease.htm).
